options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: Reverse Area 8
options.doc:
Remove the wall from the Hatchling Room going to Queen Arena, allowing you to fight the Queen
Metroid from behind and navigate Area 8 backwards.

options.name: Knowledge
options.doc: Tricks that require knowledge of how the game works or offscreen portions of the map.

options.name: Wall Jump
options.doc:
Jump off of walls in midair.

Disable: Wall jumping will not be required by logic
Simple: Logic can expect wall jumping to high ledges and up shafts
Intermediate: Logic can expect wall jumping into tight spaces

options.name: Super Jump
options.doc:
Double tap B when jumping up from the ground to gain extra height.

Beginner: Simple jumps to get more height jumping straight up
Easy: Start to tilt the stick on the second B press for a higher spin jump
Medium: Tighter jumps that may also require morph extends

options.name: Infinite Bomb Jump
options.doc:
Fly by bomb jumping in midair.

Disable: Bomb jumping in midair will not be required by logic
Double: Bomb jump in midair once, usually unmorphing in midair to grab ledges
Vertical: Infinite bomb jump straight up to gain great height
Diagonal: IBJ off the sides of bombs to fly at angles

options.name: Morph Extend
options.doc:
Midair morph and unmorph to extend your Power Grip range.

Easy: Grab ledges that are just out of reach with other movement options
Medium: Tighter extends including ones chained out of things like super jumps

options.name: Damage Boost
options.doc:
Taking damage and knockback to gain distance, or otherwise deliberately as part of navigation.

Static: Hitting spikes, or brief contact with thorns and purple liquid.

options.name: Movement
options.doc: Miscellaneous movement tricks not encompassed by other logic options.

options.name: Tanks Refill Ammo
options.doc:
Makes collecting a tank refill its ammo to full capacity. In vanilla, only Energy and Aeion get
refilled to maximum capacity.

options.name: Display Room Names
options.doc: Display the names of rooms at the bottom of the touch screen map

options.name: Fusion Suit
options.doc: Change Samus's suit to the Fusion suit
options.doc_fr: Changer le costume de Samus pour le costume Fusion

options.name: Pickup Models
options.doc:
How to display pickups.

Full: Pickups for other Metroid games appear as the matching item
Native: Pickups for other Metroid: Samus Returns players appear as themselves
Local: Pickups for other players appear as AP items; pickups for yourself appear as usual
Hidden: All pickups (including your own!) look the same

options.name: AP Item Models
options.doc:
How to display external "AP Items."

Progression: Progression items are RDV logos, and non-progression items look like Nothing items
Generic: All AP items are RDV logos
